summary: Critical React hydration failure detected. The Next.js 16 app renders HTML server-side but client-side JavaScript fails to hydrate React components. All forms (login, register) submit as regular HTML forms instead of being handled by React, causing page reloads with '?' appended to URL. Supabase API works correctly (verified via curl), but frontend cannot make authenticated requests.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration failure - forms submit as HTML forms instead of React-handled submissions

integration_issues.issue: Cannot login or register - React event handlers not attached due to hydration failure

issues: Landing page renders correctly with hero section, navigation links (Sign In, Get Started), and feature sections

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix React hydration failure in Next.js 16 app
Investigate why window.__NEXT_DATA__ is not present
Check if 'use client' directives are properly set on client components
Verify React/ReactDOM bundles are loading and executing correctly
Check for any hydration mismatch errors in server logs
Consider adding suppressHydrationWarning or investigating SSR/CSR mismatch
critical_code_review_comments: React is not hydrating - hasReact: false, hasReactDOM: false, hasNextData: false after 10+ seconds
Form elements have no React fiber attached (formHasFiber: false, buttonHasFiber: false)
Forms default to HTML GET method instead of React onSubmit handler
Supabase API works correctly (tested via curl - signup returns access_token)
WebSocket HMR connections fail with 502 but this is expected in preview environment

success_rate.frontend: 10% (Landing page loads, but all interactive features broken)

seed_data_creation: Created test user via Supabase API: testcurl@pawtrail.test
context_for_next_testing_agent: React hydration is completely broken. The app renders HTML but React never hydrates. All form submissions fail because React event handlers are not attached. Supabase backend works correctly - verified via curl. The issue is purely frontend React/Next.js hydration. Check: 1) window.__NEXT_DATA__ is missing, 2) React/ReactDOM globals are undefined, 3) No React fiber on DOM elements. This blocks ALL authentication and interactive features.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Next.js 16 React hydration failure - client-side JavaScript not executing to hydrate server-rendered HTML
reproduction_steps: 4. Observe: Page reloads with '?' appended to URL instead of making API call
5. Verify: window.__NEXT_DATA__ is undefined, React/ReactDOM globals are undefined
evidence: hasReact: false, hasReactDOM: false after 10 seconds
formHasFiber: false, buttonHasFiber: false - no React fiber attached

SSR/CSR mismatch causing hydration to fail silently
Possible issue with AuthProvider or layout component
